nodes.text: Look at this chart. The kobold tunnels run straight for the deep chamber where the star-stone sits. I don't deal in why. I deal in galleries, and I want mine back working.
The star-stone. And a nest, something with more legs than a work crew. The sweepers won't pass the junction anymore. Sensible of them.

choices.text: I'll deal with all of it.

nodes.text: Clear the diggers, clear the nest, then cut me six of silver off the deep lodes so the book shows the galleries pay. Take a light past the junction. That's policy.
Sensible. Like the sweepers. The chart keeps.
